invariants.rationale: The method always returns a TiledMap object from a delegated loader, and never null.
The file argument is required for loading the map and would not be null at this point.
The extension is always computed from file, so it cannot be null.
The method only returns after loading a TMX or TMJ file; otherwise, it throws an exception.
Regardless of loader source, the result is always a TiledMap.
